A too-late tech-skeptical – oh s*** LLMs can be fun
c.f. autocrats sacrifice science on the altar of technology.

brew install ollama # llama.cpp wrapper + docker for models in Go
ollama serve # watch the log!

# open a new terminal screen
ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b  # install Alibaba's model – 1GB 
ollama run qwen2.5-coder:1.5b # run it – 5GB ram

You can now watch both sides of the conversation. At the moment my understanding is that this will not route any of your precious model interaction to our magnanimous overlords. But beware the rot and the default opt-ins.

Have fun!

uses homebrew, Ollama, Qwen2.5-Coder:1.5b
on 2020 M1 Macbook Air 16GB RAM
